t: Unified health rollup — Archive Reliability Dashboard
title: Unified health rollup — Archive Reliability Dashboard
description:
The archive reliability dashboard is the single pane of glass for trust: availability, integrity, latency, failures, and recovery status across every collection and service, in plain language with drill-down for engineers. It turns the output of all the other maintenance tools — health checks, scanners, forecasters — into a story leadership and users can read at a glance. When something is wrong, the dashboard is where everyone looks first.

This record documents the unified health rollup approach: Roll per-service health into collection, system, and network scores with transparent weighting.

Teaching ladder rank 1 (foundations): this record explains the core idea in plain terms — what inputs the tool takes, what outputs it produces, and when it is the right choice for an archive task.
